vulnerability.name: File Upload Vulnerabilities
vulnerability.description: Security flaws in file upload functionality that can lead to various attacks
vulnerability.impact: Remote code execution, web shell deployment, denial of service, or data corruption
vulnerability.mitigation: Validate file types and content, use secure upload directories, implement size limits and virus scanning

findings.title: Unvalidated File Upload
findings.explanation: No validation is performed on the file type or content when uploading to the contract.
findings.impact: An attacker can potentially execute arbitrary code on the contract by uploading a malicious script as a file.
findings.execution_path_diagram:
```
	-	airDrop()
    |            |
    |            |-	Bank.supportsToken()
    |            |- requires clause
    |            |- keccak256(abi.encodePacked("Nu Token")) == bank.supportsToken()
    |            |
    |            |- tokenBalance[msg.sender] == 0
```
exploitation_steps: Upload a malicious script as a file to the contract using airDrop()
The contract executes the uploaded script due to lack of validation
findings.remediation: Validate the file type and content before allowing a file upload, sanitize user input using safe methods.
